user.title: ZoneFlow Irrigation
user.description: Give this irrigation zone a short name (e.g. "Front Lawn", "Avocado Tree"). To add more zones later, add this integration again.

data_description.zone_name: Becomes the zone's device name and the start of its entity names, and shows in phone messages. E.g. "Tomato bed", "Front lawn".
data_description.plant: Fills in sensible starting values for this crop: weekly water targets, crop factor, deep soak and growth ramp. "Something else" starts from general values. You can change all of them later on the zone's device page.
data_description.zone_type: Outdoor is how ZoneFlow has always worked. Greenhouse and indoor zones add climate control (fans, vents, misting, heater), can work without a valve, and have no rain gauge or forecast because of the roof.

entities.title: ZoneFlow Irrigation
entities.description: Point this at your real entities. It never creates new physical entities of its own. Only the valve switch is required -- everything else below degrades gracefully when left unset.

data_description.valve_entity: The switch that opens this zone's valve (or starts its pump). The only thing ZoneFlow can't work without: it switches it on and off, and always makes sure it ends up off.
data_description.pump_power_entity: A power sensor (W) on the pump, e.g. from a smart plug. During each watering ZoneFlow checks that the pump really draws power, and warns you if it doesn't. Leave empty if you don't have one.
data_description.pump_id: Only for zones that run from the same pump: give them all the same name here (any name, e.g. "Pump A") and they take turns instead of running at the same time. Leave empty if this zone has its own pump or water supply.
data_description.rain_counter_entity: A rain gauge counter that goes up by one with every tip of its bucket. ZoneFlow then subtracts rain from what it waters, lets wet soil dry out first, and stops a watering when it starts raining. How much rain one tip is, you set on the zone's device page (Rain Gauge mm per Tip). Without a gauge, ZoneFlow waters as if it never rains.
data_description.outdoor_temp_entity: An outdoor temperature sensor. With it, ZoneFlow waters more in hot weather and less in cool weather by itself, and the frost guard holds watering off when it's freezing. Without it, the Fallback / Manual Temperature setting decides.
data_description.flow_meter_entity: A water meter that counts up the total volume (litres, gallons or m³). ZoneFlow then logs how much water each watering really used, warns you if the pump ran but no water moved, and can measure the flow rate for you (Configure → Flow rate).
data_description.soil_moisture_entity: A soil moisture sensor (%) in this zone's root zone. Dry soil brings the routine watering forward, wet soil skips it, and in between the normal schedule decides. The dry and wet levels are on the zone's device page.
data_description.notify_entity: Your phone's notify entity from the Home Assistant Companion app. ZoneFlow sends faults and notable events there, and the weekly summary if you turn it on. Without one, they only go to the log.
data_description.weather_entity: A weather entity with a forecast. ZoneFlow holds a watering off when enough rain is forecast (but not for too many days in a row), and uses its current temperature for the frost guard when there's no temperature sensor.
data_description.soil_type: Decides how each watering is split into pulses, so the water soaks in instead of running off: about 3 mm per pulse on clay, 15 mm on loam, 30 mm on sand, with a 30-minute soak between pulses (an hour on clay and clay loam). "Not sure" uses a cautious middle value. You can also change it later on the zone's device page.
data_description.drainage: Slow-draining soil (a hard, compact layer underneath) takes less water per pulse and gets an hour's soak between pulses.
data_description.slope: Water runs off a slope before it soaks in: a moderate slope adds one pulse to each watering, a steep one two.
data_description.irrigation_method: How the water is delivered. With drip or a soaker hose on sandy soil a new zone starts with at least two pulses, so the water stays in the root zone. How much water it gives is set by the flow rate (Configure → Flow rate).
data_description.growth_ramp_profile: Gives young plants less water and grows it to the full weekly target as they get older, counted from the Planting / Transplant Date on the zone's device page. Off: always the full target. Custom: draw your own curve on the device page.
data_description.csv_path: A file where every watering, skip and warning is written with its numbers, for checking what ZoneFlow did (opens in any spreadsheet). The suggested file in your config folder is fine.
data_description.deep_soak_enabled: A deep soak is a big, slow watering every couple of weeks (14 days to start with) that wets the soil deep down, so roots grow deep. Good for trees, shrubs and perennials; turn it off for shallow-rooted plants like salad and herbs. The routine watering runs either way.
data_description.deep_soak_time: When the deep soak starts on the days it's due, when its trigger below is the fixed time. Early morning is best: less water lost to sun and wind.
data_description.routine_time: When ZoneFlow checks each day whether the routine watering is due, and waters if it is. How often it's due follows the weather and your weekly target. Early morning is best.
data_description.deep_soak_sun_mode: Start the deep soak at the fixed time above, or before or after sunrise or sunset, so it moves with the seasons.
data_description.deep_soak_sun_offset_minutes: How many minutes before or after sunrise or sunset. Not used with the fixed time.
data_description.routine_sun_mode: Start the routine watering at the fixed time above, or before or after sunrise or sunset, so it moves with the seasons.
data_description.routine_sun_offset_minutes: How many minutes before or after sunrise or sunset. Not used with the fixed time.
data_description.unit_system: What this zone shows: follow Home Assistant, or always metric (mm, °C, litres) or imperial (inches, °F, gallons). It only changes what you see, never how much it waters.

climate.title: Climate
climate.description: What is the growing season like where this zone is? This only pre-fills the temperature sliders on the next page -- you can change every value there, and later on the zone's device page.

data_description.climate: Pick the closest match. It only fills in the temperature thresholds on the next page.

temperatures.title: Temperature thresholds
temperatures.description:
ZoneFlow averages the daily HIGH temperature over the last 3 days. At or above Hot it waters more often (every 3 days) with the hot weekly target; below Cool it uses the cool weekly target; in between is normal.

The fallback temperature is used when there is no real reading to go on: with no temperature sensor it is your manual control (raise it for a heat wave, lower it for a cold spell); with a sensor it is used only until the sensor has recorded its first full day, and after 3 days without a single reading.

data_description.hot_temp_threshold: When the average of the last 3 days' highs is at or above this, the zone uses its Hot weekly target and waters more often.
data_description.cool_temp_threshold: When that average is below this, the zone uses its Cool weekly target. In between is normal weather.
data_description.fallback_temp: Used when there's no real reading. Without a temperature sensor this is your manual control: raise it for a heat wave, lower it for a cold spell.

greenhouse_devices.title: Climate devices and sensors
greenhouse_devices.description: Point this at your real sensors and devices. All are optional, but a fan, vent, mister or heater needs the inside temperature sensor. You can add or change them later under Configure.

data_description.inside_temp_entity: The temperature sensor inside the greenhouse or room. Needed for any fan, vent, mister or heater, and used for watering too.
data_description.inside_humidity_entity: A humidity sensor inside. Lets ZoneFlow vent or mist by humidity and stop misting when it is damp enough.
data_description.light_entity: A light sensor (lux or solar radiation). Can start misting on bright days.
data_description.outdoor_temp_entity: A temperature sensor outside. With it, ZoneFlow only ventilates to cool when the outside air is cooler than inside, so it never pulls hotter air in. Without it, it works from the inside readings only.
data_description.fan_entities: Fans that cool or exhaust. Any switch, input boolean or fan. They all switch together.
data_description.vent_entities: Roof or side vents: covers, or switches that open them. They all move together.
data_description.mister_entities: Misters or foggers: a switch or valve. ZoneFlow runs them in short pulses and always makes sure they end up off.
data_description.heater_entities: Heaters: a switch, or a climate entity. Switched on when it gets too cold.
data_description.notify_entity: A phone notification target for warnings, such as a failed sensor. Leave empty for none.
data_description.unit_system: Show temperatures in Celsius or Fahrenheit. Automatic follows Home Assistant.
data_description.backup_temp_entities: Optional, recommended for a greenhouse with a heater. Extra temperature sensors inside, best placed away from the main one. If the main sensor stops working, control carries on with the first backup that works, and you get a message.

water_valve.title: Does this zone water?
water_valve.description: Pick the valve switch if this zone waters its plants. Leave it empty for a climate-only zone (then it needs at least one device).

data_description.valve_entity: The switch that opens this zone's valve. Leave empty for a climate-only zone that doesn't water.

flow_rate.title: Emitter flow rate
flow_rate.description: How much water the zone's emitters put on the area they wet. 1 litre on 1 m² is 1 mm. For drippers at single plants, use the area around them that actually gets wet. The result replaces the zone's Emitter Flow Rate Calibration.

data.emitters: Number of emitters (drippers, sprayers) in the zone

data_description.emitters: Count every dripper or sprayer this zone's valve feeds.
data_description.emitter_flow: What one emitter gives per hour: it's printed on the emitter or its packaging (e.g. 2 L/h, 0.5 gal/h).
data_description.area: The area that actually gets wet. For drippers at single plants, add up the wet patches around them, not the whole bed.

flow_measure.title: Measure the flow rate
flow_measure.description: Runs the valve for {minutes} minutes as a service run (not counted as watering, but its minutes count toward today's runtime safety cap) and works the flow rate out from the flow meter's litres. The meter must only measure this zone's water while it runs. The result comes as a phone message and is set automatically; switching Service Mode off cancels it.

data_description.area: The area the zone's emitters actually wet. For drippers at single plants, add up the wet patches around them, not the whole bed.

abort.flow_rate_out_of_range: That works out to {rate}, outside what the setting allows ({low} to {high}). Check the numbers -- for drippers spaced around single plants, use the area they actually wet, not the whole bed.
abort.measuring: Measuring: the valve runs for about {minutes} minutes. The result comes as a phone message (or in Home Assistant's notifications if the zone has no phone target) and is set automatically.
abort.zone_not_loaded: This zone isn't running right now, so this can't be done.
abort.zone_busy: The zone (or its pump) is busy, or today's runtime safety cap is used up. Try again later.
abort.flow_rate_disabled: The zone's Emitter Flow Rate Calibration entity is disabled. Enable it (the zone's device page → its entities) and try again.

run_deep_soak.name: Run Deep Soak
run_deep_soak.description: Runs the deep-soak cycle now if (and only if) the same gates the 05:00 schedule uses are satisfied (mutex free, 14-day interval + dry-down met, 14-day rain ceiling not exceeded). Identical code path to the scheduled run.

device_id.description: The zone's device. Only needed with 2+ zones configured.

entity_id.name: Zone Entity
entity_id.description: Any entity belonging to the zone's device (alternative to Zone Device).

run_routine_irrigation.name: Run Routine Irrigation
run_routine_irrigation.description: Runs the routine irrigation cycle now if (and only if) the same gates the 05:30 schedule uses are satisfied. Identical code path to the scheduled run.

device_id.description: The zone's device. Only needed with 2+ zones configured.

reset_lock.name: Reset Irrigation Lock
reset_lock.description: Force-clears the mutex lock and abort flag. Emergency use only.

device_id.name: Zone Device
device_id.description: The zone's device. Only needed with 2+ zones configured.

entity_id.name: Zone Entity
entity_id.description: Any entity belonging to the zone's device (alternative to Zone Device).

snooze_today.name: Snooze Today
snooze_today.description: Skips whichever of this zone's scheduled cycles (deep soak, routine, or both) hasn't already run today, without changing any other setting. Normal scheduling resumes automatically starting tomorrow.

device_id.name: Zone Device
device_id.description: The zone's device. Only needed with 2+ zones configured.

entity_id.name: Zone Entity
entity_id.description: Any entity belonging to the zone's device (alternative to Zone Device).

test_pulse.name: Test Pulse
test_pulse.description: Bypasses every schedule/dry-down/rain gate and runs one short valve pulse, for bench-testing the valve/pump wiring before trusting the real schedule. Still respects the mutex lock and safety watchdogs.

device_id.name: Zone Device
device_id.description: The zone's device. Only needed with 2+ zones configured.

entity_id.name: Zone Entity
entity_id.description: Any entity belonging to the zone's device (alternative to Zone Device).

send_weekly_summary.name: Send Weekly Summary Now
send_weekly_summary.description: Sends the weekly summary now to every phone that has a zone with a Weekly Summary day set -- a preview; the week's counts carry on until the scheduled one.

add_rain.name: Add Rain
add_rain.description: Records rain read by hand from a simple rain gauge. It counts like gauge rain for the rain credit, deep soak and the dry-down, but not for the 30-minute "raining now" checks. On a zone with its own rain gauge the higher of the two counts, never the sum.

amount.name: Amount
amount.description: Rain in the zone's units (mm, or inches on an imperial zone).

when.name: When
when.description: When the rain fell (default now). At most 14 days back.

device_id.name: Zone Device
device_id.description: The zone's device. Only needed with 2+ zones configured.

entity_id.name: Zone Entity
entity_id.description: Any entity belonging to the zone's device (alternative to Zone Device).

date_in_future.message: This date can't be in the future: it records something that already happened. Only the Planting / Transplant Date may be set ahead.

cool_not_below_hot.message: The cool weather threshold has to stay below the hot weather threshold. To move both down, lower the cool one first; to move both up, raise the hot one first.

zone_busy.message: This zone is busy (watering or already running a service run). Try again when it's finished.

pump_busy.message: The pump this zone shares is in use by another zone right now. Try again when that zone has finished.

daily_cap_reached.message: This zone has reached today's maximum runtime safety cap, so no service run can start until tomorrow (or raise the Max Daily Irrigation Runtime cap).

zone_paused.message: This zone is paused. Switch Pause off to water it.

pause_until_past.message: Pick a date and time in the future to pause until.

no_weekly_summary.message: No zone has a Weekly Summary day and a phone notify target set, so there's nothing to send.

summary_send_failed.message: The weekly summary couldn't be sent: the phone notification failed. Check the zone's notify target.

zone_has_no_valve.message: This zone has no valve, so it can't water. Add a valve under Configure if you want it to.

manual_rain_zero.message: Set the Manual Rain amount above 0 first.

manual_rain_not_outdoor.message: Manual rain is only for outdoor zones.

manual_rain_future.message: Rain can't be entered for a time in the future.

manual_rain_too_old.message: Rain can be entered at most 14 days back.

valve_unavailable.title: {zone}: valve unavailable
valve_unavailable.description: The valve of zone {zone} ({entity}) has been unavailable for over an hour, so the zone can't water. Check the valve's device and its integration. This clears by itself once the valve is back.

shared_valve.title: {zone}: valve shared with another zone
shared_valve.description: Zone {zone} and zone {other_zone} are both configured with the same valve entity ({entity}). Unless they also share a Pump ID or pump power sensor, ZoneFlow can't tell they're the same physical valve and won't stop them from opening it at the same time. Give one of the zones its own valve, or set a matching Pump ID on both under Configure.

sensor_offline.title: {zone}: sensor offline for {days} days
sensor_offline.description: {entity}, which zone {zone} uses, has been offline for {days} days. The zone carries on without it (see what that means in the README), but check the device -- or remove it from the zone under Configure. This clears by itself once the sensor reports again.

notify_missing.title: {zone}: phone notify target missing
notify_missing.description: Zone {zone} sends its phone notifications to {entity}, which no longer exists in Home Assistant, so no notifications arrive. Pick the current notify target under the zone's Configure. This clears by itself once it exists again.

flow_rate_default.title: {zone}: calibrate the emitter flow rate
flow_rate_default.description: Zone {zone} still uses the default Emitter Flow Rate Calibration (0.24 mm/min). It's the one number that decides how much water each run gives, so measure it for your emitters: the zone's Configure → Flow rate works it out from your emitters, or measures it with a flow meter. If 0.24 mm/min really is right for this zone, ignore this.

greenhouse_sensor.title: {zone}: inside temperature sensor not working
greenhouse_sensor.description: The inside temperature sensor of zone {zone} ({entity}) has not given a usable reading for a while, so the climate control is on its failsafe: the misters and heater are off, and the vents and fans follow the Sensor Failsafe setting. Check the sensor. This clears by itself once it reports again.

greenhouse_outside_sensor.title: {zone}: outside temperature sensor not working
greenhouse_outside_sensor.description: The outside temperature sensor of zone {zone} ({entity}) has not given a usable reading for a while. Ventilation carries on from the inside readings only, so it can't check that the outside air is cooler. Check the sensor. This clears by itself once it reports again.

greenhouse_device.title: {zone}: a climate device is not responding
greenhouse_device.description: Zone {zone} switched its {devices} but they did not report the change, even after a second try. Check the device and its integration. This clears by itself once the devices respond.

greenhouse_mist_halted.title: {zone}: misting stopped
greenhouse_mist_halted.description: A mister of zone {zone} would not switch off when told to, so misting has been stopped to avoid flooding. Check the mister, then press Reset Irrigation Lock on the zone to start misting again.

greenhouse_on_backup_sensor.title: {zone}: running on the backup temperature sensor
greenhouse_on_backup_sensor.description: The main inside temperature sensor of zone {zone} ({entity}) has stopped working, so the climate control is using a backup sensor. Check the main sensor. This clears by itself once it reports again.

greenhouse_sensor_mismatch.title: {zone}: inside temperature sensors disagree
greenhouse_sensor_mismatch.description: The main inside temperature sensor of zone {zone} ({entity}) reads {main} while the backup reads {backup}, and they have been far apart for a while. One of them is probably wrong or badly placed (in direct sun, next to the heater). Check both. This clears by itself once they agree.
